18:30 Local Time, 13:00 GMT, 18:30 IST: Hello and welcome, everyone! It’s time for the third and final T20I between Afghanistan and India in Delhi before both teams head to Japan for the 2026 Asian Games. Afghanistan have made huge strides in white-ball cricket over the last few years, but they have struggled to compete in this series, losing both games comprehensively. The first two games have followed a strikingly similar pattern: India have won the toss, put Afghanistan in, and watched them falter at different stages - in the powerplay in the first T20I and during the middle overs in the second - and then post below-par totals on a good batting surface with short boundaries, only for India to race through the chases, smashing 82 runs in the powerplay and finishing with plenty of overs to spare each time. Can Afghanistan finally break the script tonight and, more importantly, register their first-ever win over India? We won’t have to wait long to find out.

At the end of the second T20I, Shreyas Iyer hinted that India could hand game time to those yet to feature in the series. Vaibhav Sooryavanshi, Washington Sundar and Yash Thakur are the three players waiting in the wings. The sensational 15-year-old opener Sooryavanshi could come in for Abhishek Sharma, while the team management may not want to rest Sanju Samson after his blistering fifty in the second T20I, having struggled for runs before that knock. Thakur and Washington, meanwhile, could replace Jasprit Bumrah and Shivam Dube/Axar Patel respectively. Alright, stay tuned for the toss and team news...
